title: SIR model with random diffusion, reinfection, and random transmission: exponential attractors and spread of the disease
summary: We introduce a stochastic SIR-type partial differential equation model incorporating random diffusion, reinfection, vital dynamics, and a randomly varying transmission rate. For the associated random dynamical system, we prove the existence of both random and exponential attractors. We construct a non-stationary, random disease-free global solution, which serves to localize the random attractor.
